Separately, the production tool executor `caliber_proxy.tools.execute` already coerces non-strings and never raises (`claude_hooks/caliber_proxy/tools.py:438-439`), so the non-string scenario only bites custom/injected executors.

**One hardening change:** strip `"error"` and `"_role_failed"` from the researcher tombstone return at `consultants/engine/council.py:564-565` (keep the `"research"` tombstone text and RoleTurn, which are additive and already carry the failure signal race-safely downstream). One edit fixes both failure modes: (a) a single dead lane no longer flips the consultation to `status=failed` at `runner.py:174` despite a real synthesized answer; (b) `error` and `_role_failed` are no longer written from parallel lanes, closing the LastValue multi-lane abort vector (`graph.py:74-75`). The tombstone text inside `research` is what the synthesizer — and the user — should see: an answer with a visibly missing lane, status=completed. (Note: the `error` key was deliberate per the audit comment at `council.py:557-561`, but its intent — avoiding a confidently-degraded answer — is already satisfied by the visible tombstone in the report; single-instance role failures like planner/synthesizer at `council.py:452-453,736-737` keep their `error` keys, so genuine pipeline failures still surface.)
